book.title: Crit Hit & Run
invariants: No convenient amnesia as a continuity device.

chapters.title: 100% Crit Chance, 0% Survival Rate
chapters.goal: Artie awakens in the world of Aethelgard with a glitched Luck stat that guarantees critical hits but locks his HP at 1.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a confused casualty of reality to a high-stakes gambler where any damage is permadeath.

bridge.from_prev: Artie's mundane life ends in a freak server-room accident.
bridge.to_next: Artie must find a way to kill the Tutorial Guardian without taking a single point of chip damage.

chapters.title: The Tutorial is a Speedrun
chapters.goal: Exploit the 'Perfect Dodge' mechanic to clear the starter zone in record time and trigger a hidden achievement.
chapters.stakes_shift: Acquiring legendary-tier starter gear makes Artie a target for envious high-level players early on.

bridge.from_prev: Artie survives the initial spawn and realizes the System rewards 'No-Hit' runs.
bridge.to_next: The achievement grants Artie a map to a forgotten dungeon that requires high movement speed.

chapters.title: Glass Cannon in a Stone World
chapters.goal: Cross the treacherous Iron Peaks to reach the trade hub of Oakhaven before his 'Newbie Protection' buff expires.
chapters.stakes_shift: Environmental hazards introduce threats that cannot be 'critically hit' or easily dodged.

bridge.from_prev: Artie leaves the tutorial zone with a unique title and a massive target on his back.
bridge.to_next: Artie arrives at Oakhaven only to find the gates barred to anyone without a guild voucher.

chapters.title: The Math of Murder
chapters.goal: Enter the 'Infinite Spire' solo to prove his glass-cannon build can outpace the System's scaling difficulty.
chapters.stakes_shift: Artie discovers that the System's 'Anti-Cheat' AI is monitoring his anomalous combat logs.

bridge.from_prev: Artie sneaks into the Spire to farm the resources needed for a guild voucher.
bridge.to_next: The AI deploys a 'Stalker' entity specifically designed to counter high-crit builds.

chapters.title: Friends with Benefits (and Buffs)
chapters.goal: Recruit a disgraced shield-maiden, Silna, to act as a literal meat-shield for Artie's fragile existence.
chapters.stakes_shift: Artie's solo exploitation becomes a team effort, complicating his 'Hit & Run' tactics with social loyalty.

bridge.from_prev: Artie barely escapes the Stalker and realizes he needs a tank to survive the next floor.
bridge.to_next: Silna agrees to help if Artie assists her in reclaiming her stolen family heirloom from a local tyrant.

chapters.title: The Raid on Red-Tier Keep
chapters.goal: Utilize a 'Damage Overflow' exploit to one-shot a regional boss that usually requires a forty-man raid.
chapters.stakes_shift: The boss's death destabilizes the local political power, making Artie a kingmaker (or a criminal).

bridge.from_prev: Artie and Silna infiltrate the Keep using a combination of stealth and high-speed kiting.
bridge.to_next: The boss drops a 'World Key' that Artie wasn't supposed to find for another fifty levels.

chapters.title: Level Up and Get Out
chapters.goal: Escape the collapsing Keep and the arriving System Moderators while securing the stolen treasury loot.
chapters.stakes_shift: Artie officially becomes Aethelgard's most wanted 'Glitch,' forcing him into the permanent shadows.

bridge.from_prev: The World Key activates, signaling the end of the 'Tutorial Era' for the entire server.
bridge.to_next: Artie and Silna head toward the lawless 'Grey Zones' to hide and plan their next exploit.

sections.title: The Server Room Incident
sections.intent: Establish Artie's mundane life and the catalyst for his transition to Aethelgard.
sections.end_condition: Artie is electrocuted during a server-room surge and loses consciousness.

sections.title: The Glass Cannon Awakening
sections.intent: Introduce the glitched status and the immediate danger of the 1 HP constraint.
sections.end_condition: Artie confirms his stats show 100% Critical Hit Chance and exactly 1/1 HP.

sections.title: The Tutorial Guardian
sections.intent: Demonstrate the 'Hit & Run' combat style against the first major threat.
sections.end_condition: The Tutorial Guardian is defeated without Artie taking a single point of damage.

sections.title: Mastering the Perfect Dodge
sections.intent: Artie exploits the game's i-frame mechanics to survive low-level mob aggro.
sections.end_condition: Artie successfully chains ten 'Perfect Dodges' in a single encounter.

sections.title: The Speedrunner's Shortcut
sections.intent: Artie uses his knowledge of game geometry to bypass standard tutorial gates.
sections.end_condition: Artie reaches the hidden 'Developer's Backdoor' in the starter zone.

sections.title: The Hidden Achievement
sections.intent: Secure the legendary-tier starter gear through a 'No-Hit' clear achievement.
sections.end_condition: The System grants the 'Untouchable Legend' title and the associated gear set.

sections.title: Into the Iron Peaks
sections.intent: Transition from the safe tutorial zone to the high-stakes open world.
sections.end_condition: Artie crosses the threshold into the Iron Peaks territory.

sections.title: Environmental Hazards
sections.intent: Show that the environment is just as deadly as monsters for a 1 HP build.
sections.end_condition: Artie survives a scripted rockslide using high-speed kiting.

sections.title: The Gates of Oakhaven
sections.intent: Establish the next major obstacle: the social and guild-based gatekeeping.
sections.end_condition: Artie is refused entry to Oakhaven for lacking a guild voucher.

sections.title: The Spire Infiltration
sections.intent: Artie sneaks into the solo-challenge dungeon to farm the necessary voucher.
sections.end_condition: Artie bypasses the external guards and enters the Infinite Spire instance.

sections.title: Climbing the Floors
sections.intent: Demonstrate the scaling difficulty and Artie's reliance on one-shotting enemies.
sections.end_condition: Artie clears the tenth floor, triggering a system-wide difficulty spike.

sections.title: The Anti-Cheat Shadow
sections.intent: Introduce the System's awareness of Artie's anomalous performance.
sections.end_condition: Artie receives a 'Suspicious Activity' notification from the System AI.

sections.title: The Disgraced Shield-Maiden
sections.intent: Introduce Silna and establish her current low status in Oakhaven.
sections.end_condition: Artie locates Silna in a back-alley pit-fighting ring.

sections.title: The Tyrant's Heirloom
sections.intent: Provide Silna with a motivation to join Artie's high-risk mission.
sections.end_condition: Silna agrees to the partnership in exchange for help reclaiming her family crest.

sections.title: The Unlikely Duo
sections.intent: Establish the tactical synergy between a 1 HP crit-machine and a pure tank.
sections.end_condition: Artie and Silna successfully complete a practice skirmish together.

sections.title: Infiltrating the Red-Tier Keep
sections.intent: The duo enters the highest-level zone in the region using stealth and speed.
sections.end_condition: Artie and Silna reach the inner sanctum of the Keep undetected.

sections.title: Setting up the Overflow
sections.intent: Artie prepares the mechanical conditions for a massive damage exploit.
sections.end_condition: All necessary debuffs are applied to the boss, and Artie's buffs are maxed.

sections.title: The One-Shot Kill
sections.intent: The final execution of the exploit and the resulting world-state change.
sections.end_condition: The Regional Boss is vaporized by a single hit, dropping the World Key.

sections.title: The Loot & The Chaos
sections.intent: Artie and Silna secure the treasury rewards while the Keep collapses.
sections.end_condition: The treasury is emptied and the World Key is secured in Artie's inventory.

sections.title: The Moderator Arrival
sections.intent: Raise the stakes by introducing the physical manifestation of the Anti-Cheat AI.
sections.end_condition: The System Moderators arrive at the Keep's ruins to investigate the glitch.

sections.title: The Great Escape
sections.intent: Artie and Silna flee to the lawless zones to avoid deletion.
sections.end_condition: Artie and Silna cross the border into the Grey Zones, vanishing from the System's primary radar.
